_comment: Government schemes for which eligibility can be checked against a farmer profile. Each rule is sourced and auditable.
_disclaimer: Eligibility rules are simplified for this demo. Actual eligibility involves additional documentation and verification by government agencies. Always verify with the official portal.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000.
schemes.exclusions: Institutional landholders; constitutional post holders; serving/retired central/state government officers (except MTS/Group D); professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers); income tax payers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or visit a Common Service Centre.
schemes.source: PM-KISAN Official Portal, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Free soil testing and a printed Soil Health Card with nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations, issued every 2 years.
schemes.exclusions: None — open to all farmers including tenants and sharecroppers.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at soilhealth.dac.gov.in or contact the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
schemes.source: Soil Health Card Portal, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance against losses from natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Farmer premium is capped at 2% for kharif crops.
schemes.exclusions: Voluntary for non-loanee farmers. Some states have opted out of certain seasons.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through the bank where the crop loan is availed, or online at pmfby.gov.in.
schemes.source: PMFBY Official Portal, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
